thread:
Maya (AE): @sam need urgent help — Acme Corp POC wants a pilot discount. Quote Q-54321. They want 50% for 60 days to validate integration. Pilot needs to start tomorrow morning :zap: Can deal desk approve within 4h?
Devon (AM): Is this a revenue commit or a no-commit pilot? we should know expected ARR if we make an exception. Also need to set CPQ flags so it routes to expedited flow.
Maya (AE): No revenue commit — pure evaluation. Acme is strategic partner signal, potential enterprise later. If 50% is impossible we'll accept 30% for the pilot. Need something in writing we can show them by EOD.
Sam (Deal Desk): Ok — triage steps: 1) confirm it's a no-commit POC, 2) confirm SQ is done, 3) populate CPQ fields for expedite. Normal SLA for approvals is 24h, expedited can be 4–8h depending on discount depth. >40% discount will need Legal + Finance signoff. Please attach SOW + SQ.
Luca (SE): FYI technical: customer requires Private deployment and stricter access. Also needs an NDA addendum. Add CPQ field `private_deploy_required = true` and `ndatype = "addendum"`. Small sample CPQ payload to route to expedited queue:
```
// CPQ field map
quoteId: "Q-54321"
poc_commit: "no"
pilot_override: "true"
pilot_length_days: "60"
private_deploy_required: "true"
expedite_reason: "Strategic partner POC"
requested_discount_pct: "50"
```
Sam (Deal Desk): Thanks Luca. Upload SOW + completed security questionnaire here and I'll kick off /dealdesk-request. Important: pilot_override up to 35% can be handled by Sales Ops. Anything >35% requires VP approval and Legal review. Also add `deal_risk` and `expected_ar` fields.
Maya (AE): Uploaded SOW: https://files.redwood.example/sow/acme-poc-draft.pdf and SQ done (link: https://files.redwood.example/sq/acme-completed.pdf). If we can't get 50% I'll take 30% and add a canary clause to limit spend to $5k.
Sam (Deal Desk): Received. Kicking off expedited review now via /dealdesk-request. Current routing rules:
- pilot_override <= 35% -> Sales Ops approval (target 4h)
- 35% < pilot_override <= 40% -> Deal Desk + Finance (target 8h)
- >40% -> Deal Desk + Finance + Legal + VP (target 24h)
For this thread: since requested 50%, I'll ping Legal immediately. If you can accept 30% we can try Sales Ops path and likely get signoff faster. Mark CPQ: `pilot_override_pct=50`, `pilot_length_days=60`, `deal_risk=low`, `private_deploy_required=true`. Expected resolution timestamp: 1845125600. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon (AM): If approved at 30% we need to set `billing_hold_until` to end of trial and ensure we reconcile for any conversion. Also clarifying: will billing start after pilot or upon signed enterprise contract? Add `billing_trigger = on_conversion` or `on_first_invoice`.
Sam (Deal Desk): Copy. I'll try Legal for the 50% ask but flag the faster path for 30%. Starting expedited review and will update this thread ASAP. If Legal needs redlines for the SOW/NDA I'll loop in LegalOps. :white_check_mark:
